title: The coefficient comparisons and actual finite-reduction Hom tower
statement: Let X be a scheme and A a commutative ring, in the coefficient universe of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and let J be an ideal. Use constant and completed coefficient sheaves B = lim_n underline(A/J^(n+1)) and projections q_n [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence], standard derived localizations [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and exact restriction to the slice over U [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction]. Retain the original derived etale comparison, completed constant realization, cohomology, slice restriction, and tensor-cohomology definitions. Define local reduction R_n by extension along q_n|U. Its successor scalar-associativity comparison is the normalized balancing isomorphism of [lem-sfb-adic-constructible-finite-reductions]. For T,M in D(B|U), define G_n = Hom(R_n T,R_n M) and successor map f sent to e_T inverse, followed by scalar extension of f, followed by e_M. Define its section induced by g:T -> M using R_n(g); naturality of e proves compatibility. Define weak contractibility on this same slice as surjectivity of evaluation of every epi of coefficient-universe set sheaves at its final object.
